suggestions.title: Goodfellas
suggestions.description: The rise and fall of a mob associate who becomes deeply enmeshed in New York's organized crime underworld. Martin Scorsese's masterful gangster epic features career-defining performances by Ray Liotta, Robert De Niro, and Joe Pesci, with one of cinema's most famous tracking shots.

suggestions.title: Spider-Man: Into the Spider-Verse
suggestions.description: Teenager Miles Morales becomes Spider-Man and teams up with Spider-People from across the multiverse to save reality. A groundbreaking visual masterpiece that pushed the boundaries of animation, winning the Academy Award for Best Animated Feature.
suggestions.director: Bob Persichetti, Peter Ramsey, Rodney Rothman

suggestions.title: Schindler's List
suggestions.description: During WWII, German businessman Oskar Schindler saves over a thousand Polish Jews from the Holocaust by employing them in his factories. Steven Spielberg's deeply moving historical drama is an essential, emotionally devastating masterpiece that won 7 Academy Awards including Best Picture.

shown_titles: The Good, the Bad and the Ugly
